title: Trump names bomb thrower Steven Cheung as communications director
description_short: Trump names bomb thrower Steven Cheung as communications director
description_medium: On November 15, 2024, Donald Trump selected campaign spokesman Steven Cheung to lead communications for his incoming White House. The announcement also named Karoline Leavitt, then a campaign spokesperson, as press secretary. The appointments document who Trump chose for two senior communications roles as his administration prepared to take office.
description_long: On November 15, 2024, Trump announced that Steven Cheung, his 2024 campaign spokesman, would serve as communications director in the incoming White House. He also selected Karoline Leavitt to be press secretary. The choices carried campaign communications staff into senior roles for the next administration and established the public-facing team that would speak for the White House. The supplied reporting describes the appointments; it does not establish what communications policies or press practices the officials later adopted. Cheung's appointment is the event captured by this entry, while Leavitt's selection is part of the same staffing announcement. The title's phrase “bomb thrower” is an editorial characterization rather than a formal job description, so the account here identifies Cheung by his campaign role and the office he was named to hold. No broader national-security or policy consequence is inferred from the appointments alone.
